title: Functional Group Identification Flashcard Game
author: Dr. Dan
description: Interactive flashcard-style study game for identifying 16 common organic functional groups. Includes Picture to Name, Name to Picture, and Mixed Practice modes. Students practice recognizing alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, arenes, haloalkanes, alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, thiols, sulfides, disulfides, amines, amides, esters, ethers, and carboxylic acids.
